items.title: Germany's Merz backs Hungary's new pro-EU course
items.description: After talks with Hungary's new prime minister, Peter Magyar, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz expects a positive reset in EU relations. Meanwhile, Budapest has signaled only a partial shift so far on support for Ukraine.

items.title: Parliamentary elections in Armenia: What's at stake
items.description: Armenians are set to vote on the country's future geopolitical direction at the June 7 ballot. It will be a test of public opinion in Russia’s longstanding ally that has seen a gradual drift towards the EU.

items.title: Unpacking Germany's campaign for a UN Security Council seat
items.description: On Wednesday, the United Nations will hold elections for several seats on the UN Security Council. Germany's government is campaigning vigorously for a seat.
